CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS n8n_elite_action_ledger (
  action_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('claimed','completed','failed')),
  value JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  result JSONB,
  error JSONB,
  claimed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  failed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_n8n_elite_action_ledger_status_updated
  ON n8n_elite_action_ledger(status, updated_at DESC);

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO n8n_elite_action_ledger(action_key,status,value,claimed_at,updated_at)
  VALUES ($1,'claimed',$2::jsonb,NOW(),NOW())
  ON CONFLICT(action_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins) AS claimed,
  $1::text AS key,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT row_to_json(ins) FROM ins LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT row_to_json(l) FROM n8n_elite_action_ledger l WHERE l.action_key=$1)
  ) AS record;

UPDATE n8n_elite_action_ledger AS l
SET status='completed', result=$2::jsonb, completed_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW()
WHERE l.action_key=$1
RETURNING l.action_key AS key, row_to_json(l) AS record;

UPDATE n8n_elite_action_ledger AS l
SET status='failed', error=$2::jsonb, failed_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW()
WHERE l.action_key=$1
RETURNING l.action_key AS key, row_to_json(l) AS record;

SELECT l.action_key AS key, row_to_json(l) AS record
FROM n8n_elite_action_ledger AS l WHERE l.action_key=$1;
DELETE FROM n8n_elite_action_ledger WHERE action_key=$1 RETURNING action_key AS key;
